1. 概述和基本概念

核心功能

FiftyOne 提供了一个强大的标注 API，用于：

  • 为数据集添加新标签
  • 编辑现有标签
  • 与外部标注工具集成（如 CVAT、Label Studio、Labelbox）

重要提示

  • 可以通过安装 @voxel51/annotation 插件在 FiftyOne App 内直接管理标注
  • 提供了完整的教程示例展示标注工作流程

2. 基本工作流程

六步标注流程

import fiftyone as fo
import fiftyone.zoo as foz
from fiftyone import ViewField as F

#Locate a subset of your data requiring annotation
# Create a view that contains only high confidence false positive model
# predictions, with samples containing the most false positives first
most_fp_view = (
    dataset
    .filter_labels("predictions", (F("confidence") > 0.8) & (F("eval") == "fp"))
    .sort_by(F("predictions.detections").length(), reverse=True)
)
# Let's edit the ground truth annotations for the sample with the most
# high confidence false positives
sample_id = most_fp_view.first().id
view = dataset.select(sample_id)

3. 配置和设置 Setup

3.1 更改标注后端 Changing your annotation backend

有三种方式设置标注后端：

方式1: 在特定运行中指定

You can use a specific backend for a particular annotation run by passing the backend parameter to annotate():


view.annotate(..., backend="labelstudio", ...)

python
运行
  • 1
  • 2
方式2: 通过环境变量设置会话默认值

You can change your default annotation backend for an entire session by setting the FIFTYONE_ANNOTATION_DEFAULT_BACKEND environment variable.

export FIFTYONE_ANNOTATION_DEFAULT_BACKEND=labelbox

python
运行
  • 1

方式3: 在配置文件中永久设置

You can permanently change your default annotation backend by updating the default_backend key of your annotation config at ~/.fiftyone/annotation_config.json:

# ~/.fiftyone/annotation_config.json
{
    "default_backend": "cvat",
    "backends": {
        "cvat": {...}
    }
}

  • 1
  • 2
  • 3
  • 4
  • 5
  • 6
  • 7

3.2 配置后端参数 Configuring your backend

Annotation backends may be configured in a variety of backend-specific ways, which you can see by inspecting the parameters of a backend’s associated AnnotationBackendConfig class.

The relevant classes for the builtin annotation backends are:

  • “cvat”: fiftyone.utils.cvat.CVATBackendConfig

  • “labelstudio”: fiftyone.utils.labelstudio.LabelStudioBackendConfig

  • “labelbox”: fiftyone.utils.labelbox.LabelboxBackendConfig

You can configure an annotation backend’s parameters for a specific run by simply passing supported config parameters as keyword arguments each time you call annotate():

# 直接传递配置参数
view.annotate(
    anno_key,
    backend="cvat",
    url="http://localhost:8080",
    username="your_username",
    password="your_password",
)

4.2 标签模式 (Label Schema)

完整的标签模式定义
label_schema = {
    "new_field": {
        "type": "classifications",
        "classes": ["class1", "class2"],
        "attributes": {
            "attr1": {
                "type": "select",
                "values": ["val1", "val2"],
                "default": "val1",
            },
            "attr2": {
                "type": "radio",
                "values": [True, False],
                "default": False,
            }
        },
    },
    "existing_field": {
        "classes": ["class3", "class4"],
        "attributes": {
            "attr3": {
                "type": "text",
            }
        }
    },
}

支持的标签类型
  • "classification": 单一分类
  • "classifications": 多标签分类
  • "detections": 目标检测
  • "instances": 实例分割
  • "polylines": 折线
  • "polygons": 多边形
  • "keypoints": 关键点
  • "segmentation": 语义分割
  • "scalar": 标量值

4.3 类别特定属性

label_schema = {
    "new_field": {
        "type": "detections",
        "classes": [
            {
                "classes": ["class1", "class2"],
                "attributes": {
                    "attr1": {  # 仅适用于 class1 和 class2
                        "type": "select",
                        "values": ["val1", "val2"],
                    }
                }
            },
            "class3",
            "class4",
        ],
        "attributes": {
            "attr2": {  # 适用于所有类别
                "type": "radio",
                "values": [True, False],
            }
        },
    },
}

4.4 属性类型

CVAT 支持的属性类型：

  • text: 自由文本输入
  • select: 下拉选择
  • radio: 单选按钮
  • checkbox: 复选框

4.5 编辑限制

view.annotate(
    anno_key,
    label_field="ground_truth",
    allow_additions=False,      # 禁止添加新标签
    allow_deletions=False,      # 禁止删除标签
    allow_label_edits=False,    # 禁止修改标签值
    allow_spatial_edits=False,  # 禁止修改空间属性
    allow_index_edits=False,    # 禁止修改视频轨道索引
)

8. 自定义标注后端

If you would like to use an annotation tool that is not natively supported by FiftyOne, you can follow the instructions below to implement an interface for your tool and then configure your environment so that the annotate() and load_annotations() methods will use your custom backend.

8.1 实现要求

需要实现三个类：

  1. AnnotationBackend: 核心上传/下载逻辑
  2. AnnotationBackendConfig: 配置参数
  3. AnnotationResults: 跟踪运行状态

8.2 配置自定义后端

// ~/.fiftyone/annotation_config.json
{
    "default_backend": "custom",
    "backends": {
        "custom": {
            "config_cls": "your.custom.AnnotationConfig",
            // 自定义参数
        }
    }
}

最佳实践建议

  1. 内存限制: 确保标注运行中的所有标签可以装入内存
  2. 大规模视频: 考虑分批进行标注
  3. **使用 Dataset.stats() 评估标签大小
  4. 合理设置编辑限制，避免意外修改
  5. 定期清理完成的标注任务，释放后端资源
  6. 保存标注配置，便于复用和团队协作

这个标注系统的设计非常灵活，既支持简单的标注任务，也能处理复杂的多字段、多属性标注需求。通过合理配置，可以实现高效的标注工作流程。
